bill.title: An Act amending Title 35 (Health and Safety) of the Pennsylvania Consolidated Statutes, providing for Maternal Health Monitoring Pilot Program.

posted_text:
❤️‍🩹 Reproductive Rights
PA SB 965 — PA Could Offer Tech to Watch Over Pregnant Women’s Health

Pennsylvania is considering a new pilot program to improve maternal health. Starting in 2026, the state will partner with managed care organizations and a tech vendor to offer remote patient monitoring for pregnant women at risk of high blood pressure or diabetes. ...
